assumptions.note: Illustrative estimate only: profit is assumed to be 20% of revenue when estimating corporate tax.

corporate_tax.description: Singapore has a flat corporate income tax rate of 17% on chargeable income.

partial_exemption.description: All companies enjoy partial tax exemption on normal chargeable income.

first_10000.explanation: 75% exemption on the first $10,000 of chargeable income

next_190000.explanation: 50% exemption on the next $190,000 of chargeable income

startup_exemption.description: Tax Exemption Scheme for New Start-Up Companies — available for the first 3 consecutive Years of Assessment (YA).
eligibility: Company must be incorporated in Singapore
Must be a tax resident in Singapore for that YA
Must have no more than 20 shareholders throughout the basis period
At least one shareholder holds at least 10% of issued ordinary shares
Not applicable to property developers or investment holding companies

first_100000.explanation: 75% exemption on the first $100,000 of chargeable income

next_100000.explanation: 50% exemption on the next $100,000 of chargeable income

filing_requirements.estimated_chargeable_income: File ECI within 3 months of the financial year end
filing_requirements.corporate_tax_return: File Form C-S, Form C-S (Lite), or Form C by 30 November each year
filing_requirements.form_cs_eligibility: Revenue of $5 million or less, only Singapore-sourced income, not claiming certain deductions

gst.description: Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a broad-based consumption tax levied on the supply of goods and services in Singapore.

registration_rules.retrospective: Mandatory if taxable turnover exceeded $1 million in the past 12 months
registration_rules.prospective: Mandatory if taxable turnover is expected to exceed $1 million in the next 12 months
registration_rules.voluntary: Businesses below the threshold may register voluntarily but must remain registered for at least 2 years

responsibilities: Charge and account for GST on taxable supplies
Issue tax invoices for standard-rated supplies
Maintain proper records for at least 5 years

personal_income_tax.description: For sole proprietorships and partnerships, business income is taxed as the owner's personal income.
personal_income_tax.note: Personal income tax rates in Singapore are progressive, ranging from 0% to 22% (for income above $320,000).
